description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs (trillion floating-point operations) for four different configurations of the SepLLM model, with the y-axis representing the loss ratio on a linear scale ranging from 94% to 100% and the x-axis representing TFLOPs on a logarithmic scale from 1e7 to 9e8. The legend identifies four distinct lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing SepLLM (n=64), an orange line with diamond markers representing SepLLM (n=128), a green line with diamond markers representing SepLLM (n=64, H), and a red line with circle markers representing SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The purple line remains relatively flat, starting at approximately 99.8% and staying near 100% across the entire TFLOPs range. The orange line starts at about 98.2% and increases to a peak of approximately 100.2% at 4e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The green line begins at around 97.5% and rises to a peak of about 100.2% at 5e8 TFLOPs, then slightly decreases. The red line starts at 94% and shows a steep increase, reaching approximately 98.8% at 2e8 TFLOPs, after which it continues to rise more gradually, peaking at about 99.1% at 4e8 TFLOPs before declining to around 98.8% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
